image_description: A close-up shot of a young girl blowing large soap bubbles. She is holding a green plastic bubble wand near her mouth. Several large, translucent bubbles are visible in the foreground and mid-ground, exhibiting strong iridescent rainbow colors (greens, pinks, blues) and reflecting/distorting the background. The girl's face is partially obscured by the bubbles and the wand.
